name: Isuru Madusanka Rodrigo
title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
tagline: Building clean, scalable web applications with real-world production experience.
summary: I am a dedicated and forward-thinking Software Engineer with hands-on experience in full-stack web development, backend engineering, and UI/UX implementation. Currently completing my BSc (Hons) in Information & Communication Technology at Rajarata University of Sri Lanka, I have practical industry experience working on real production systems, including gaming platforms and large-scale booking applications.
detailedSummary: During my internship at eSupport Technologies, I contributed to backend feature development, frontend refactoring, authentication systems, and database improvements using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, and SQL. I value clean architecture, maintainable code, and disciplined engineering practices, and I am actively seeking opportunities to grow as a professional software engineer.
careerObjective: To leverage my full-stack development skills and industry experience to build impactful, production-grade software in a collaborative engineering team, while continuously growing as a developer and contributing to meaningful projects.
